metadata.description: nativelite plugins for Claude Code: skills and tooling for the agent-terminal suite, starting with atrium's coordination skills.

plugins.name: atrium
plugins.description: Fleet & coordination skills for atrium (tmux for coding agents): atrium-fleet designs, configures, and runs saved atrium.fleet.json rosters, while atrium-coordinate and atrium-delegate teach a hosted claude to drive the atrium control plane, coordinating and delegating work across teammate agent panes.
